page.purpose: Space Grotesk page heading; approved scale.

identifier.purpose: Geist Mono for codes and literal data.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Approved primary action, geometry and response.
components.css: .commons-primary { box-sizing:border-box; background:#DBE0E8; color:#12161C; border:0; border-radius:8px; min-height:44px; padding:12px 16px; font:500 13px/1.4 Geist,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 3px 7px #0005; transition:transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),background 140ms; } .commons-primary:hover { background:#F3F5F8; transform:translateY(-1px); } .commons-primary:active { transform:translateY(2px) scale(.99); } .commons-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #BCCADC; outline-offset:5px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .commons-primary { transition:none; } .commons-primary:hover,.commons-primary:active { transform:none; } }

components.name: Project field
components.description: Persistent label, readable text and border-only focus; no outer outline or shadow.
components.html: <label class="commons-label" for="commons-field">Project name</label><input class="commons-field" id="commons-field" value="Commons launch">
components.css: .commons-label { display:block; margin-bottom:8px; color:#C2C7D0; font:400 12px/1.6 Geist,sans-serif; } .commons-field { box-sizing:border-box; width:100%; height:44px; padding:0 12px; background:#17191D; color:#EEF0F3; border:1px solid #677282; border-radius:8px; font:400 15px/1.4 Geist,sans-serif; caret-color:#C8D0DC; } .commons-field:focus { outline:none; box-shadow:none; border-color:#8C97A6; }

components.name: Shared note
components.description: Attributed, durable context on a reflective graphite surface.
components.html:
Note by Codex

The platform is ready for launch.

Product notes are ready for the next assistant.
components.css: .commons-note { box-sizing:border-box; padding:32px; background:linear-gradient(145deg,#202328,#17191D 58%); color:#C2C7D0; border:1px solid #677282; border-radius:14px; font:400 15px/1.8 Geist,sans-serif; } .commons-note .commons-byline { margin:0 0 24px; font-size:12px; color:#A7AEBA; } .commons-note h2 { margin:0 0 12px; font:500 26px/1.3 "Space Grotesk",sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.025em; color:#EEF0F3; } .commons-note p { margin:0; }

narrative.overview: The owner approved the font families, dark-only character, Graphite + Reflective, type scale, spacing, corners and interaction response. Text fields use a subtle existing-border change on focus with no outer outline, ring, glow or shadow. Apply these foundations throughout the mock; production product implementation remains separate.

rules.name: Stable reading
rules.body: Reflection responds on the surface; text remains still.

rules.name: Deliberate alternate
rules.body: Sora is stored as an alternate, not an automatic fallback.

dos: Use semantic roles and shared values.
Review relevant component states, keyboard behavior and reduced motion.
donts: Do not reintroduce an outer text-field focus outline, ring, glow or added shadow.
Do not add a light theme or blanket colored note-hover flashes.
